g.text: Same network and patches as the previous figure. Monitor: distance to the nearest class in the 96 hidden units, with class means and covariances from the training
set. Each outside set: 1 800 patches. Stream in (c): 90 % inside the domain, 10 % outside (equal thirds); dots mark the threshold that passes 95 % of in-domain
inputs; flagged inputs go to a safe fallback.
